name: chatllm-workspace

scripts.rag:audit: uvx pip-audit -r rag-service/requirements.txt && uv pip install --dry-run --require-hashes -r rag-service/requirements.txt
scripts.predev: npm run check:config && npm run check:ports && npm run dev:infra
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,rag,client -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:rag" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:infra:minimal: docker compose up -d redis rag-cache-redis postgres minio
scripts.dev:infra:pgbouncer: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.pgbouncer.yml --profile pgbouncer up -d postgres pgbouncer
scripts.test: node --test scripts/check-env.test.mjs scripts/check-ports.test.mjs scripts/capacity-check.test.mjs scripts/load-smoke.test.mjs scripts/ops-check.test.mjs scripts/rag-smoke.test.mjs scripts/run-rag-service.test.mjs scripts/safe-error.test.mjs scripts/rag-answer-eval.test.mjs scripts/rag-answer-run.test.mjs client/vite-proxy-target.test.mjs client/build-config.test.mjs client/ui-copy.test.mjs client/export-conversation.test.mjs client/chat-drafts.test.mjs client/chat-lifecycle.test.mjs && npm --prefix client run test -- --run && npm --prefix server run test && node scripts/run-rag-service.mjs --test
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint

description: ChatLLM 是一个前后端分离的 AI 聊天与 Agentic RAG 知识工作台，支持项目空间、多格式知识库、混合检索、知识图谱、质量评测、Trace 和使用追踪。
